welcome.title: Welcome to Bubble.up
welcome.body: Bubble.up helps you find your people for every course and keep all your studying in one place. Let's get you set up in a few quick steps.

profile.title: Set up your profile
profile.body: Tell us your university and department so Bubble.up can find the right courses and groups for you. While you're in Settings, feel free to explore and set your other preferences just right for you.

enroll.title: Enroll in your courses
enroll.body: Add the courses you're taking this term — your Bubbles and recommendations are built from them.

bubble.title: Get into your first Bubble
bubble.body: A Study Bubble is a small, collaborative group for one course — chat, a shared calendar, files, and live study rooms, all in one place. No Bubble for your course yet? Create one and invite classmates, or join an existing one.
bubble.joined: You're in a Bubble! Click Next to continue.
bubble.empty: No bubbles in your courses yet — be the first to create one.
bubble.joinError: Couldn't join this Bubble. Try again.

matching.title: Trending vs Matching
matching.body: New here? Your picks start as Trending (popular Bubbles). Answer Daily Drops to raise your profile strength — once it's high enough, you'll get Matched Bubbles tailored to you. Answer your first one to finish.
